query: Here is our named-account list with CRM notes and product usage data. Which accounts should the team focus on this week and why?
expected_behavior: Returns a short ranked list (not a market summary), each account with a named signal, an absolute recency date, and a concrete next step
Classifies each account into one motion (new-logo, recovery, or expansion)
Prioritizes internal evidence (CRM, usage) and treats public triggers as supplementary
Does not recommend an account solely because it is large
